title: Suspicious person near apartments

title: Suspicious person near apartments

title: Ugh traffic is so bad today

title: Street light broken near park

title: This neighborhood is the worst

title: Why is everyone so rude

title: Suspicious email from bank

title: Gas leak smell near residential area

title: Thunderstorm warning issued
description: Local weather authorities have issued a thunderstorm warning for the evening. Heavy rain, lightning and strong winds expected. Stay indoors if possible.

title: ATM skimming device found
description: A skimming device was discovered on an ATM near the metro station. Customers who used the ATM in the last 48 hours are advised to check their statements.

title: Chain snatching incident
description: A woman reported her gold chain was snatched by two men on a bike near the market area. Police have registered a case and are reviewing CCTV footage.
